name: world-8x
title: I26 HD Textures 8x Cockpit & Cars
note: The 8x cockpit and cars pack as released in 2026.11.23 (2026-11-05, its later fixes mirrored from the 4x's). Run by tools/hd-pack.py world-8x; it shares world-4x's export and masters steps. Placeholders as in world-4x.json.

used_for.4xTextures_GTAV_rgt-s_dither.pth: everything not in a family: 4x, then 2xHDCube_Compact to 8x (the masters)
used_for.2xHDCube_Compact.pth: the masters' second pass; a family model's 4x taken to 8x (--x2-model)
used_for.4xHDcube-Alpha.pth: the cut-out outlines of gauges, needles, misc. (the alpha step)

steps.note: the cockpit families' models at 8x and their alpha step, kept as PNGs (2026-11-05)
the cars' textures (and the weapons' side strip zdue) from the masters at 8x
the cockpit by family at 8x from the family masters; the mission maps stay at 4x
the damage panel's sprite sheets a cell at a time at 8x (2026-11-10)
the steering wheel's and the arms' outlines at 8 texels a pixel
the wheel's and the arms' frames recut by their smooth outline (2026-11-08)
the lettered textures the 8x has, set again from free fonts
the masks' smooth outlines at 8 texels a pixel
the cars' painted two-tone edges and small lamps at 8x

the radar's 62 frames drawn again over the pack's own (style B, the lock-range labels) and the range plate's and lamp's sheets made from them, which go with them (2026-11-26); the smooth sweep's layers beside them (zrads_face, zrads_grid.png, zrads.json)

the damage panel's wires drawn again as tubes fitted to the original's, and a light wear (grime, chipped paint, fine scratches, an uneven print) laid alike on the damage panel, its lights' every state and the counters' five housings, what the game stamps left as it is (2026-11-26; the level awaits the owner's pick from the contact sheet)
